services.desc: Silver Spring Stage partners with OvationTix for ticket sales. Tickets may also be purchased at the box office approximately one hour before each performance. Silver Spring Stage brings its 59th season of exciting theater to the community! Enjoy a mix of classical and contemporary plays as well as our annual One-Act Festival. For $233.55 (or $194.75 for Seniors/Students) - or $216.75 ($184.75 for Seniors/Students) until August 24 - enjoy a full season of seven plays, our holiday show, and 50% off tickets to both weekends of the 2026 One-Act Festival.
